summary: JM Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on June 18, 2026, reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary JM Manufacturing (HK) Limited issued a promissory note to CEO, Chairman, and major shareholder Chun Kwok Stanley Ting for a principal amount of up to HK$15,065,000. The note is non-interest-bearing, matures on May 31, 2033, and proceeds are for working capital and operating expenses. This is an ordinary financing arrangement between a related party and the company, not a special situation transaction such as a tender, acquisition, or restructuring. As a foreign private issuer report, it is equivalent to a US domestic report of material events.
